newsitem.title: DENMARK: Quiet Danish shares seen holding new lower level.
newsitem.headline: Quiet Danish shares seen holding new lower level.

text.p: Danish share prices closed lower on Wednesday with dealers seeing levels holding on Thursday in quiet trade with many European bourses - but not Copenhagen - closed due to the May Day holiday.

"I don't see much happening tomorrow as so many exchanges will be off. We fell today due to purely psychological reasons, the market did not react to the U.S. GDP data nor has the Dow index done much yet," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index closed 1.32 point down at 154.77 while the KFX June future rose 0.45 point to 155.70 with 290 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Overall turnover for the day was 720 million crowns.
